tolerances.timing: bay to plain plating and bay to the idle static must agree within 1 s (samples every 0.25-0.5 s)
tolerances.play: score values are multiples of 50; a hit costs a life; the third loss shows GAME OVER PRESS FIRE TO START and fire starts a new game with 3 lives; level structures scroll in during play. Score totals are compared as ranges only, because the level advances with the player's input (with no input it never leaves the plating) and kit input goes through the host's HTTP path

gomoku.tolerances: Black opens at the centre; every declared result has the winner's five in a row on the final board; White's win share agrees within 20 points.
